extras.approval_status: APPROVED by project owner 2026-08-31, per plan.md decision D7 — as decided below over two sub-questions.

government_groups_citation.claim: The 2022-2026 governing coalition formed after the Sept 2022 election: ODS (16 seats, primátorka Dagmar Škodová Parmová — the city's first woman mayor) + 'Společně pro Budějovice' (KDU-ČSL + TOP 09, 3 seats, klub label 'KDU-TOP09') + Piráti (3 seats) + Jihočeši 2012 (1 seat) = 23 of 45, the narrowest majority. Coalition agreement signed before the 2022-10-24 constitutive session.

Piráti (3 seats) left the coalition without warning just before the 2024-10-21 council session; the coalition dropped to 20/45 and has governed as a minority ever since, still led by ODS. Piráti kept their 'PIRÁTI' klub label in the voting data (leaving the coalition is a political act, not a klub change).

After South-Bohemian governor Martin Kuba announced (late 2025) a new movement over disputes with ODS's national leadership, 14 of ODS's 16 city councillors — including primátorka Škodová Parmová and 3 deputy mayors — left ODS. In this repo's own derived data (ceske-budejovice/data/memberships.csv) those exact 14 people change klub label 'ODS' -> 'NEZAŘAZENÍ' at meeting 2025026 (2025-12-15), then 'NEZAŘAZENÍ' -> 'NAŠE ČESKO' at meeting 2026029 (2026-05-11); the other two (Jiří Borovka, Petr Pelech) stayed 'ODS'. The coalition continued 'in the same personnel composition' — i.e. the same people kept governing under the new label.

resolved_questions.question: Piráti governed only ~2 of the 4 years (walked out 2024-10-21). Include them in the single static government_groups list?
resolved_questions.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-31 by project owner: EXCLUDE Piráti — government_groups reflects the bloc that governed for the majority of the term (2024-10 onward). Same 'lesser inaccuracy' logic the owner applied to Hradec Králové's Rozvíjíme Hradec. Piráti therefore read as opposition throughout govity/wpca.

resolved_questions.question: The ODS klub (the primátorka's) is labelled 'ODS' then 'NEZAŘAZENÍ' then 'NAŠE ČESKO' across the term — same 14 people governing throughout. Which org id(s) represent them?
resolved_questions.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-31 by project owner: use ALL THREE — ods + nezarazeni + nase-cesko. Verified clean: those three klub orgs contain exactly the 14 continuing ex-ODS councillors and no unrelated people (the only other 'NEZAŘAZENÍ'/independent movement in the data is the 3 ex-SPD members who became 'NEZÁVISLÍ', a separate klub). The 2 ODS members who did not follow Kuba (Borovka, Pelech) stay under 'ods' and are thus still counted as government — a known ~2-person edge the owner accepted as immaterial.
